SELECT b.ORGNZT_NM, a.ESNTL_ID, a.USER_NM, a.EMPL_NO, a.OFCPS_NM FROM NEMPLYRINFO a LEFT OUTER JOIN NORGNZTINFO b ON a.ORGNZT_ID = b.ORGNZT_ID WHERE 1=1
AND COALESCE(b.ORGNZT_NM, ' ') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
AND COALESCE(a.USER_NM, ' ') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
ORDER BY b.ORGNZT_NM, a.USER_NM ASC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(EMPLYR_ID) as cnt FROM NEMPLYRINFO a LEFT OUTER JOIN NORGNZTINFO b ON a.ORGNZT_ID = b.ORGNZT_ID WHERE 1=1
AND COALESCE(b.ORGNZT_NM, ' ') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
AND COALESCE(a.USER_NM, ' ') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')

SELECT A.SCHDUL_ID, A.SCHDUL_SE, A.SCHDUL_NM, B.SCHDUL_DE, A.SCHDUL_BGNDE, A.SCHDUL_ENDDE, C.USER_NM LEADER_NAME, A.REPTIT_SE_CODE FROM NLEADERSCHDUL A LEFT OUTER JOIN NLEADERSCHDULDE B ON A.SCHDUL_ID = B.SCHDUL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO C ON A.LEADER_ID = C.ESNTL_ID WHERE 1=1
AND (#{searchMonth} = SUBSTRING(B.SCHDUL_DE, 1, 6) )
AND (B.SCHDUL_DE >= #{searchBgnDe} AND B.SCHDUL_DE <= #{searchEndDe})
AND (#{searchDay} = B.SCHDUL_DE)
AND SCHDUL_SE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND C.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeywordEx}, '%')
ORDER BY SCHDUL_BGNDE

SELECT A.SCHDUL_ID, D.SCHDUL_DE, A.SCHDUL_SE, A.SCHDUL_NM, A.SCHDUL_CN, A.SCHDUL_PLACE, A.LEADER_ID, B.USER_NM LEADER_NAME, A.REPTIT_SE_CODE, A.SCHDUL_BGNDE, A.SCHDUL_ENDDE, A.SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, C.USER_NM SCHDUL_CHARGER_NAME, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM NLEADERSCHDUL A LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO B ON A.LEADER_ID = B.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO C ON A.SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID = C.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NLEADERSCHDULDE D ON A.SCHDUL_ID = D.SCHDUL_ID WHERE A.SCHDUL_ID = #{schdulId} AND D.SCHDUL_DE = #{schdulDe}
mapper.update: UPDATE NLEADERSCHDUL SET SCHDUL_SE=#{schdulSe}, SCHDUL_NM=#{schdulNm}, SCHDUL_CN=#{schdulCn}, SCHDUL_PLACE=#{schdulPlace}, LEADER_ID=#{leaderId}, REPTIT_SE_CODE=#{reptitSeCode}, SCHDUL_BGNDE=#{schdulBgnDe}, SCHDUL_ENDDE=#{schdulEndDe}, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID=#{schdulChargerId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE SCHDUL_ID = #{schdulId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, LEADER_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID )VALUES( #{schdulId}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{leaderId}, #{reptitSeCode}, #{schdulBgnDe}, #{schdulEndDe}, #{schdulChargerId}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId}, NOW(), #{lastUpdusrId} )

SELECT A.LEADER_ID, B.USER_NM LEADER_NM, D.ORGNZT_NM, E.CODE_NM LEADER_STTUS_NM, C.USER_NM LAST_UPDUSR_NM, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM NLEADERSTTUS A LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO B ON A.LEADER_ID = B.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO C ON A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID = C.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NORGNZTINFO D ON B.ORGNZT_ID = D.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CCMMNDETAILCODE E ON E.CODE_ID = 'COM061' AND A.LEADER_STTUS = E.CODE WHERE 1=1
AND B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
AND E.CODE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
ORDER BY B.USER_NM ASC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(A.LEADER_ID) as cnt FROM NLEADERSTTUS A LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO B ON A.LEADER_ID = B.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO C ON A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID = C.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NORGNZTINFO D ON B.ORGNZT_ID = D.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CCMMNDETAILCODE E ON E.CODE_ID = 'COM061' AND A.LEADER_STTUS = E.CODE WHERE 1=1
AND B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
AND E.CODE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')

SELECT A.LEADER_ID, B.USER_NM LEADER_NM, C.ORGNZT_NM, A.LEADER_STTUS, D.CODE_NM LEADER_STTUS_NM FROM NLEADERSTTUS A LEFT OUTER JOIN NEMPLYRINFO B ON A.LEADER_ID = B.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN NORGNZTINFO C ON B.ORGNZT_ID = C.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CCMMNDETAILCODE D ON D.CODE_ID = 'COM061' AND A.LEADER_STTUS = D.CODE WHERE A.LEADER_ID = #{leaderId}
